name: Dachat
description: Dachat was a planet in the area of the Core Worlds containing the Hyabb-Twith Corridor. The Nelori Marauders had a base on the planet which allowed them to prey upon both the populations on Hyabb and Twith. The base was destroyed by the Jedi in 4050 BBY.
lead_paragraphs: Dachat was a planet in the area of the Core Worlds containing the Hyabb-Twith Corridor. The Nelori Marauders had a base on the planet which allowed them to prey upon both the populations on Hyabb and Twith. The base was destroyed by the Jedi in 4050 BBY.
